always_on: Only the verified immediate-material-draw protection; broad endgame pruning change is disabled
counter_method: Own quiet beta-cutoff refutation keyed by side and previous move from/to; rank below killers; protect killers/counter from one-ply late-move reduction; null moves use no counter context
unchanged: Evaluation weights, clock allocator, TT history safety/repetition/mate rules, normal pruning apart from specified late-move protection

screen.selection: Highest completed game-point score; ties memory-only; zero technical failures

confirmation.interval: 97.5percent paired normal interval; conservative allowance for two algorithmic confirmation looks in this session

gate: All finite rules, protocol, shortest-mates, draw and sanitizer checks pass
All confirmation/external games finish without technical failures
External points no lower than reference
All four actual-clock games finish with no own failure
deadline_policy: Stop owned offline tests at deadline if necessary; preserve every completed and unfinished record; incomplete collections cannot pass promotion
